title: Mobile app release
description: Readiness criteria for a first release of an iOS and/or Android app: devices, onboarding, accounts, offline behaviour, notifications, purchases, ads and age, privacy and deletion, accessibility, errors, store assets and release evidence.
advisory: Engineering checklist written for this project. Platform and legal items (account deletion, privacy disclosures, children, ads) have NOT been reviewed against current Apple App Store, Google Play or legal sources; confirm them with authoritative documentation before treating them as mandatory rules.

questions.text: Which platforms does this release target?
Do users sign in or create an account?
Does this release include in-app purchases or subscriptions?
Is the app directed at children?
Does the app collect or store personal data (including health or habit data)?
Does the app send user data to a server or third-party service?
Must the core features work without a network connection?
Does the app send notifications or reminders?

criteria.title: Smoke test on a physical iOS device
criteria.expected: The release build installs and the main flows complete on at least one physical iPhone running the minimum supported iOS version.

verification.method: Manual smoke test on a physical device, recording device model, OS version and build revision.

task.title: Smoke-test the release build on a physical iOS device
task.description: Install the release build on a physical iPhone at the minimum supported iOS version and run the main flows. Record device, OS version and build revision as evidence.

criteria.title: Smoke test on a physical Android device
criteria.expected: The release build installs and the main flows complete on at least one physical Android device at the minimum supported API level.

verification.method: Manual smoke test on a physical device, recording device model, Android version and build revision.

task.title: Smoke-test the release build on a physical Android device
task.description: Install the release build on a physical Android device at the minimum supported API level and run the main flows. Record device, OS version and build revision as evidence.

criteria.title: First-run onboarding can be completed or skipped
criteria.expected: A fresh install shows onboarding that can be completed or skipped, and does not reappear after completion.

verification.method: UI test or manual run from a clean install.

task.title: Verify first-run onboarding
task.description: From a clean install, complete and separately skip onboarding; confirm it does not reappear after completion.

criteria.title: Sign-in, sign-out and access recovery work
criteria.expected: Users can create an account or sign in, sign out, and recover access (for example password reset).

verification.method: Integration or UI test against a non-production identity backend.

task.title: Verify sign-in, sign-out and access recovery
task.description: Exercise account creation/sign-in, sign-out and recovery against a non-production backend.

criteria.title: Account deletion is available in the app
criteria.expected: A signed-in user can start deletion of their account and associated data from inside the app. (Advisory: confirm current store rules.)

verification.method: Manual check on a device plus confirmation that server-side data is removed.

task.title: Provide and verify in-app account deletion
task.description: Implement or confirm an in-app path to delete the account and its data, and verify the server-side removal.

criteria.title: Core flows work offline on a physical device
criteria.expected: With network disabled (airplane mode), core flows work and data entered offline is kept.

verification.method: Manual test in airplane mode on a physical device; emulator network toggles do not count.

task.title: Verify core flows in airplane mode on a physical device
task.description: Disable all networking on a physical device, run the core flows, relaunch, and confirm data is kept.

criteria.title: Notification permission and reminder delivery
criteria.expected: Permission is requested in context, denial is handled, and scheduled reminders fire while the app is closed.

verification.method: Manual test on a physical device with the app terminated; record OS power-saving settings.

task.title: Verify notification permission handling and reminder delivery
task.description: On a physical device, test grant and denial of notification permission and confirm reminders fire while the app is closed.

criteria.title: Purchase flow completes in the store sandbox
criteria.expected: Each product can be bought in the store sandbox and unlocks the right content.

verification.method: Sandbox purchase on a physical device with a test account.

task.title: Verify sandbox purchases for every product
task.description: Buy each product with a sandbox test account on a physical device and confirm entitlement.

criteria.title: Restore purchases works after reinstall
criteria.expected: After reinstalling or switching devices, restore brings back every previous purchase.

verification.method: Reinstall on a physical device and restore with the same sandbox account.

task.title: Verify restore purchases after reinstall
task.description: Reinstall the app (or use a second device), restore purchases with the same sandbox account, and confirm entitlements.

criteria.title: Ads respect consent and age settings
criteria.expected: Ads are shown only after the required consent and respect age-related settings. (Advisory: confirm current ad network and store rules.)

verification.method: Manual review of consent flow and ad configuration on a device.

task.title: Verify ad consent and age settings
task.description: Check the consent flow and ad SDK configuration for age-related settings on a device.

criteria.title: Children's app requirements reviewed
criteria.expected: Requirements for apps directed at children were reviewed against authoritative sources and met. (Advisory.)

verification.method: Documented human review against the current store programme rules and applicable law.

task.title: Review children's app requirements
task.description: Review store programme rules and applicable law for apps directed at children; record the review as evidence.

criteria.title: Privacy policy and store data disclosures match behaviour
criteria.expected: The privacy policy and store data-safety/privacy labels describe the data the app actually collects and shares.

verification.method: Human review comparing disclosures with the data inventory of this build.

task.title: Check privacy policy and store disclosures against actual data use
task.description: Compare the privacy policy and store privacy labels with the data this build collects and shares; fix mismatches.

criteria.title: Users can have server-side data deleted
criteria.expected: There is a working way to delete user data held on servers or third-party services.

verification.method: End-to-end deletion request against a non-production backend.

task.title: Verify deletion of server-side user data
task.description: Run an end-to-end deletion request against a non-production backend and confirm the data is gone.

criteria.title: Text scales with system font size
criteria.expected: At the largest system text sizes (Dynamic Type / font scale), text scales without clipping or overlapping.

verification.method: Manual check at the largest text size on each target platform.

task.title: Check layouts at the largest system text size
task.description: Set the largest system text size on each target platform and check every screen for clipping or overlap.

criteria.title: Screen reader labels and order
criteria.expected: Every interactive element has a meaningful VoiceOver/TalkBack label and a sensible focus order.

verification.method: Manual walkthrough with VoiceOver/TalkBack on a physical device.

task.title: Walk through the app with VoiceOver/TalkBack
task.description: On a physical device, navigate every screen with the screen reader and fix missing labels or focus order.

criteria.title: Network failures are recoverable
criteria.expected: Timeouts and offline errors show a clear message and a way to retry; no data is lost.

verification.method: Automated tests with injected failures, or manual network conditioning.

task.title: Test recovery from network failures
task.description: Inject timeouts and connection failures and confirm messages, retry and data preservation.

criteria.title: Release build is crash-free in a smoke test
criteria.expected: A smoke test of the release build on a physical device shows no crashes.

verification.method: Smoke test of the signed release build on a physical device with crash reporting enabled.

task.title: Run a crash-free smoke test of the release build
task.description: Run the release build on a physical device with crash reporting enabled; record any crashes.

criteria.title: Store listing assets prepared
criteria.expected: Icon, screenshots, description and support URL are ready for each target store.

verification.method: Human review of the store listing drafts.

task.title: Prepare store listing assets
task.description: Prepare icon, screenshots, description and support URL for each target store.

criteria.title: Signed release build from a tagged revision
criteria.expected: CI produces a signed release build from a tagged source revision, and the revision is recorded.

verification.method: CI job output linked to the tagged revision.

task.title: Produce a signed release build in CI
task.description: Configure CI to build and sign the release from a tagged revision and record the revision with the artifact.
